questions.question: 25 men and 45 women can complete a piece of work in 15 days, while 15 men and 60 women can complete it in 20 days. In how many days can 69 men and 67 women complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

25 men and 45 women complete work in 15 days

15 men and 60 woman complete the work in 20 days

**Formula Used:**

M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

**Calculations:**

As in both case they complete the same work 

so,

⇒ M1D1 = M2D2

⇒ (25M + 45W) times 15 = (15M+60W)times 20

⇒ (25M + 45W) times 3 = (15M+60W)times 4

⇒ 75M + 135W = 60M + 240W

⇒ 75M - 60M = 240W -135W

⇒ 15M = 105W

⇒ (M)/(W)=(105)/(15)

⇒ (M)/(W)=(7)/(1)

⇒ Efficiency of Men = 7

⇒ Efficiency of Woman = 1

⇒ Total efficiency of men and woman = 25M + 45W = 25 × 7 + 45 × 1 = 175 + 45 = 220

⇒ Total work = Efficiency × Time = 220 × 15 = 3300

Now, the Efficiency of 69 men and 67 women

⇒ Efficiency = 69 × 7 + 67 × 1 = 483 + 67 = 550

Time is taken by 69 men and 67 women to complete the work

⇒ Time = Total work / Efficiency = 3300 / 550 = 6 days

**⇒ ****Hence, The time taken by 69 men and 67 women is 6 days**

questions.question: In a 1500 m race, if vehicle P gives vehicle Q a start of 200 m, then vehicle P wins the race by 8 sec. Alternatively, if vehicle P gives vehicle Q a start of 400 m, the race ends in a dead heat. How long does vehicle P take to run 1500 m?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 1500 m

Vehicle P gives vehicle Q a start of 200 m, and P wins the race by 8 sec

If vehicle P gives vehicle Q a start of 400 m, the race ends in a dead heat

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculations:**

For case 1:

Vehicle P gives vehicle Q a start of 200 m, and P wins the race by 8 sec

⇒ Distance travel by P = 1500 m

⇒ Distance travel by Q = 1500 - 200 = 1300 m

⇒ Speed of vehicle P = (1500)/(t)

⇒ Speed of vehicle Q = (1300)/(t+8)

Now for case 2:

If vehicle P gives vehicle Q a start of 400 m, the race ends in a dead heat

⇒ Distance travel by P = 1500 m

⇒ Distance travel by Q = 1500 - 400 = 1100 m

As the race is end at dead heat, they finish the race at tie or equal time

⇒ Time taken by vehicle P = Time taken by vehicle Q

⇒ (1500)/(frac{1500){t}}=(1100)/(frac{1300){t+8}}

⇒ t=(11(t+8))/(13)

⇒ 13t = 11t + 88

⇒ 13t - 11t = 88

⇒ 2t = 88

⇒ t = 44 sec

**⇒ ****Hence, The time taken by vehicle P is 44 sec**

questions.question: If tan A - tan B - tan C = tan A tan B tan C, what is the value of A in terms of B and C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tan A - tan B - tan C = tan A tan B tan C

**Formula Used:**

tan (A - B) = (tanA - tanB)/(1+ tanAtanB)

**Calculations:**

⇒ tan A - tan B - tan C = tan A tan B tan C

⇒ tan A - tan B = tan A tan B tan C + tan C

⇒ ​tan A - tan B = tan C(tan A tan B + 1)

⇒ tan C = (tanA-tanB)/(1+tanAtanB)

⇒ tanC = tan(A - B)

⇒ C = A - B

⇒ A = B + C

**⇒ Hence, The option 1 is correct**

questions.question: The initial profit percentage on the sale of an item was 55%. If the cost price of the item went up by 24% but the selling price remained the same, what would be the new profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Given:

The initial profit percentage on the sale of an item was 55%.

Concept used:

SP = CP + CP × profit%

Here,

SP = Selling price

CP = Cost price

Calculation:

Let the CP of an article be 100a

So, profit = 100a × 55%

⇒ 55a

So, SP = 100a + 55a

⇒ SP = 155a

New CP = 100a + 100a × 24%

⇒ 100a + 24a = 124a

So, new profit = 155a - 124a

⇒ 31a

Profit% = (31a/124a) × 100

⇒ 25%

∴ The new profit percentage would be 25%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Profit increases by 55% then CP1 : SP = 20 : 31

Cost price went up by 24% then CP1 : CP2 = 25 : 31

Then, CP1 : CP2 : SP = 100 : 124 : 155 [ by making CP1 equal in both the ratio]

So, the new profit% = (155 - 124)/124 × 100 = 31/124 × 100 = 25%

questions.question: If the angles of a triangle are in the ratio of 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 3, what is the type of such triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of the angles = 1 : 2 : 3

**Concept used:**

The sum of all angles of the triangle is 180°

**Calculations:**

Let 1st angle be x

⇒ 2nd angle = 2x

⇒ 3rd angle = 3x

Now,

⇒Sum of angles = 180

⇒ x + 2x + 3x = 180

⇒ 6x = 180

⇒ x = 30°

Angles will be

⇒ 1st angle = x = 30°

⇒ 2nd angle = 2x = 2 times 30 = 60°

⇒ 3rd angle = 3x = 3 times 30 = 90°

Here, One angle is 90, so the triangle is right angled triangle

**⇒ Hence, The triangle is right angle triangle**

questions.question: A person lent a certain sum of money at the annual rate of 7 percent on simple interest and the interest received in 11 years is Rs. 920 less than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
questions.solution:

Rate = 7%

Time = 11 years

**Formula used:**

SI = PRT/100

**Calculations:**

Let the amount lent be P

Interest earned = P - 920

According to the formula,

⇒ SI = PRT/100

⇒ P - 920 = (Ptimes 7times 11)/(100)

⇒ 100P - 92000 = 77P

⇒ 100P - 77P = 92000

⇒ 23P = 92000

⇒ P = 4000

**⇒ Hence, The amount lent is Rs. 4000**

questions.question:

7x+4 lbrace { x² div (5x div 10)}rbrace - 3lbrace {5(1)/(3)-x³ div (3x² div x)} rbrace=0
questions.solution:
**Given Equation:**

7x+4 lbrace { x² div (5x div 10)}rbrace - 3lbrace {5(1)/(3)-x³ div (3x² div x)} rbrace=0

**Concept Used:**

The concept of BODMAS is used

B = Bracket

O = Of

D = Division

M = Multiplication

A =Addition

S = Subtraction

**Calculations:**

First we have to solve brackets

⇒ 7x+4 lbrace { x² div (5x div 10)}rbrace - 3lbrace {5(1)/(3)-x³ div (3x² div x)} rbrace=0

⇒ 7x+4 lbrace { x² div (x div 2)}rbrace - 3lbrace {5(1)/(3)-x³ div 3x} rbrace=0

⇒ 7x+4 lbrace {2x}rbrace - 3lbrace {(16)/(3)-(x²)/(3)} rbrace=0

⇒ 7x+8x -16 + x²

⇒ x²+15x -16 =0

⇒ x²-x +16x -16 =0

⇒ x(x - 1) + 16(x - 1) = 0

⇒ (x - 1)( x + 16) = 0

The value of x is 

⇒ x = +1 or -16

Now, The difference between the two values of x is 

⇒ Difference = 1 - (-16) = 1 + 16 = 17

**⇒ Hence, The difference between the two values** **of x is 17**

questions.question: If x² + y² + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0, then (x+y)/(x-y)= ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0

**Concept Used:**

The concept of quadratic equation is used

**Calculations:**

The given equation is 

x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0

To make the equation quadratic for x and y we have to add some values according to the coefficient of x =and y respectively 

⇒ The coefficient of x is 4x = 2 × 2 × x 

so for x, we have to add square of 2 and subtract square of 2

⇒ The coefficient of y is 2x = 2 × 1 × y 

so for x, we have to add square of 1 and subtract square of 1

So, The equation will become

⇒ x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 5 + 4 - 4 + 1 - 1 = 0

⇒ x2 + 4x + 4 + y2 + 2y + 1 + 5 - 4 - 1= 0

⇒ (x + 2)² + (y + 1)² = 0

On putting the value of x = -2 and y = -1, we get the value 0

⇒ So , x = - 2 and y = -1

The value of (x+y)/(x-y)=

⇒ (x+y)/(x-y)=(-2-1)/(-2 - (-1))=(-3)/(-1) = 3

**⇒ Hence, The value of the given equation is 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0

⇒ x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 4 + 1 = 0 

⇒ x2 + 4x + 4 + y2 + 2y + 1 = 0 

⇒ (x + 2)2 + (y + 1)2 = 0

So, x = -2 and y = -1

Then, (x+y)/(x-y)= -3/-1 = 3

**Formula used:**

Increased % = 100 + increased

Decreased % = 100 - decreased

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mask manufactured in 2019 = X × (100 + 30) = X × 130%

⇒ Mask manufactured in 2020 = (130%X) × (100 + 15) = 115% (130% of X)

⇒ Mask manufactured in 2021 = 115% (130% of X) × (100 - 40) = 60% ( 115%( 130% of X))

But according to the question,

⇒ Manufactured in 2021 = 179400

So,

⇒ 60%{115%(130% of X)} = 179400

⇒ (X × 60×115×130)/(100×100×100)= 179400

⇒ X = (179400 × 100×100×100)/(60×130×115) 

⇒ X = 200000

**⇒ Hence, The manufacture of mask in 2018 is 200000**

questions.question: The value of ((x-y)³+(y-z)³+(z-x)³)/(6(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)), where x ≠ y ≠ z, is equal to:
